pois.name: Hortus Botanicus
pois.description: botanical garden with greenhouses and buildings
pois.intro: Hortus Botanicus is a botanical garden in the Plantage district of Amsterdam, the Netherlands. It is one of the world's oldest botanical gardens.

pois.name: Nieuwmarkt
pois.intro: Nieuwmarkt is a square in the centre of Amsterdam, Netherlands. The surrounding area is known as the Lastage neighborhood.

pois.name: Café Warung Pas
pois.description: cubic orange building

pois.name: Rijksmuseum
pois.intro: The Rijksmuseum is the national museum of the Netherlands dedicated to Dutch arts and history, located at the Museum Square in the borough of Amsterdam South, close to the Van Gogh Museum, the Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam, and the Royal Concertgebouw.

pois.name: Van Gogh Museum
pois.description: picture gallery
pois.intro: The Van Gogh Museum is a Dutch art museum dedicated to the works of Vincent van Gogh and his contemporaries in the Museum Square in Amsterdam South, close to the Stedelijk Museum, the Rijksmuseum, and the Concertgebouw. The museum opened on 2 June 1973, and its buildings were designed by Gerrit Rietveld and Kisho Kurokawa.

pois.name: Anne Frank Huis
pois.intro: The Anne Frank House is a writer's house and biographical museum dedicated to Jewish wartime diarist Anne Frank. The building is located on the Prinsengracht, close to the Westerkerk, in central Amsterdam in the Netherlands.

pois.name: Koninklijk Paleis
pois.intro: The Royal Palace of Amsterdam in Amsterdam is one of three palaces in the Netherlands which are at the disposal of the monarch by Act of Parliament. It is situated on the west side of Dam Square in the centre of Amsterdam, opposite the War Memorial and next to the Nieuwe Kerk.

pois.name: Centraal Station
pois.intro: Amsterdam Centraal station is the largest railway station in Amsterdam, North Holland, the Netherlands. A major international railway hub, it is used by 192,000 passengers a day, making it the second busiest railway station in the country after Utrecht Centraal and the most visited Rijksmonument of the Netherlands.

pois.name: de Wallen
pois.intro: De Wallen is the largest and best known red-light district in Amsterdam. It consists of a network of alleys containing approximately 300 one-room cabins rented by prostitutes who offer their sexual services from behind a window or glass door, typically illuminated with red lights and blacklight.

pois.name: Dam
pois.intro: Dam Square, also known as the Dam, is a town square in Amsterdam, the capital and most populous city of the Netherlands. Its notable buildings and frequent events make it one of the best-known and most important locations in the city and the country.

pois.name: Artis
pois.intro: Natura Artis Magistra, commonly known just as Artis, is a zoo and botanical garden in the centre of Amsterdam. It is the oldest zoo in the Netherlands and fifth oldest zoo in the world that is still operating.

pois.name: Wereldmuseum Amsterdam
pois.description: ethnographic museum
pois.intro: The Wereldmuseum Amsterdam, previously known as Tropenmuseum between 1950 and 2023, is an ethnographic museum with its headquarters in Amsterdam, Netherlands. It was originally founded in Haarlem, Netherlands in 1864 under the name Koloniaal Museum and later renamed Tropenmuseum.

pois.name: Rembrandthuis
pois.description: The house where Rembrandt van Rijn lived.
pois.intro: The Rembrandt House Museum is a museum located in a former house in the Jodenbreestraat, in the center of Amsterdam. Between 1639 and 1658, the house was occupied by the Dutch painter Rembrandt van Rijn, who also had his studio and art dealership there.

pois.name: Westerkerk
pois.intro: The Westerkerk is a Reformed church within Dutch Protestant Calvinism in central Amsterdam, Netherlands. It lies in the most western part of the Grachtengordel neighborhood, next to the Jordaan, between the Prinsengracht and Keizersgracht.

pois.name: Vondelpark
pois.intro: The Vondelpark is a public urban park of 47 hectares in Amsterdam, Netherlands. It is part of the borough of Amsterdam-Zuid and situated west from the Leidseplein and the Museumplein.

pois.name: Nieuwe Kerk
pois.intro: The Nieuwe Kerk is a 15th-century church in Amsterdam located on Dam Square, next to the Royal Palace. Originally a Catholic church, it became a Dutch Reformed church in 1578.

pois.name: Nemo
pois.intro: NEMO Science Museum is a science centre in Amsterdam, Netherlands. It is located in the Oosterdokseiland neighbourhood in the Amsterdam-Centrum borough, situated between the Oosterdokseiland and the Kattenburg.

pois.name: Museumplein
pois.intro: The Museumplein is a public space in the Museumkwartier neighbourhood of the Amsterdam-Zuid borough in Amsterdam, Netherlands. Located at the Museumplein are three major museums – the Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh Museum, and Stedelijk Museum – and the concert hall Concertgebouw.

pois.name: Oude Kerk
pois.description: Kerkgebouw voor religieus en seculier gebruik. Oorspronkelijk een rooms-katholieke kerk gewijd aan Sint-Nicolaas, totdat het werd omgevormd tot een protestantse kerk met de naam Oude Kerk.
pois.intro: The Oude Kerk is a Reformed church in Amsterdam, Netherlands, being the oldest parish church in the city. The oldest structure in Amsterdam, the building was founded around 1213 and consecrated in 1306 as a Roman Catholic church by the bishop of Utrecht with Saint Nicolas as its patron saint.

pois.name: Het Scheepvaartmuseum
pois.intro: The Maritime Museum is a maritime museum in Amsterdam in the Netherlands. The museum had 419,060 visitors in 2012.

pois.name: H'ART Museum
pois.intro: H'ART Museum is an art museum located on the banks of the Amstel river in Amsterdam. Formerly a satellite of the Hermitage Museum of Saint Petersburg, Russia, the museum cut ties with the Hermitage after the Russian invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

pois.name: Amsterdam Museum
pois.description: museum over de geschiedenis van Amsterdam
pois.intro: The Amsterdam Museum, known until 2010 as the Amsterdam Historical Museum, is an Amsterdam-based museum dedicated to the city's past and present. Due to the renovation of its main location, the museum is temporarily located in the Amstelhof on the Amstel River, together with H'ART Museum and the dependence of the Museum van de Geest.

pois.name: Ons' Lieve Heer op Solder
pois.wikipedia: nl:Museum Ons' Lieve Heer op Solder
pois.intro: Ons' Lieve Heer op Solder is a 17th-century canal house, house church, and museum in the city center of Amsterdam, The Netherlands. The Catholic church was built on the top three floors of the canal house during the 1660s.

pois.name: Eye Filmmuseum
pois.intro: Eye Filmmuseum is a film archive, museum, and cinema in Amsterdam that preserves and presents both Dutch and foreign films screened in the Netherlands.

pois.name: Venustempel Sexmuseum
pois.intro: The Sexmuseum or the Temple of Venus is a sex museum located in Amsterdam, Netherlands. The museum was opened in 1985.

pois.name: Brouwerij 't IJ
pois.description: brouwerij met proeflokaal
pois.intro: Brouwerij 't IJ is a small brewery in Amsterdam, Netherlands. It is located in a former bath house named Funen, next to the De Gooyer windmill.

pois.name: 't Mandje
pois.description: Reopened after 25 years this oldest gay/lesbian bar tries to revive the times of its legendary first owner, Bet van Beren. If this will work or not, it is worth visiting as it has been restored to its original interior.
pois.intro: Café 't Mandje is a bar in Amsterdam, Netherlands. It is located in Zeedijk street and was opened in 1927 by Bet van Beeren, herself a lesbian.

pois.name: Sichuan Food
pois.intro: Sichuan Food is a Sichuan cuisine restaurant in Amsterdam, Netherlands. It was a fine dining restaurant that was awarded one Michelin star in 1993 and retained that rating until 2005.

pois.name: Vermeer
pois.intro: Restaurant Vermeer is a restaurant located in the NH Barbizon Palace hotel at the Prins Hendrikkade in Amsterdam, Netherlands. It is a fine dining restaurant that received its first Michelin star in 1993.

pois.name: De Juwelier
pois.description: à la carte-restaurant
pois.intro: De Juwelier is een restaurant in Amsterdam. Bij de uitreiking van de Michelinsterren voor 2022 ontving het een ster.

pois.name: Vinkeles
pois.intro: Vinkeles is a restaurant located in Hotel The Dylan in Amsterdam, Netherlands. It is a fine dining restaurant that was awarded one Michelin star in 2010 and retained that rating until present.

pois.name: Yamazato
pois.intro: Yamazato is a restaurant housed in the Okura Hotel in Amsterdam in the Netherlands. It is a fine dining restaurant and has had one Michelin star since 2002.

pois.name: Bistro de la Mer
pois.intro: Bistro de la Mer is een restaurant in Amsterdam. Bij de uitreiking van de Michelinsterren voor 2023 ontving het een ster.

pois.name: &moshik
pois.intro: &moshik, formerly &samhoud places, was a fine-dining restaurant in Amsterdam, Netherlands. The restaurant was awarded two Michelin stars for 2013.

pois.name: Spectrum
pois.intro: Restaurant Spectrum was a restaurant located in the Waldorf Astoria hotel in Amsterdam, Netherlands. It is a fine dining restaurant that is awarded two Michelin star since 2015.

pois.name: Belushi's Amsterdam
pois.description: Cool location with good music (alternative rock/pop) and a lot of food, beer, cocktails and extra rooms to see sports

pois.name: Caldi e Freddi
pois.description: Panini place

pois.name: Waterkant
pois.description: Modern canalside bar & eatery with Dutch & Surinamese fare, a wide choice of beer & outdoor seating.

pois.name: Comics shop Lambiek
pois.intro: Galerie Lambiek is a Dutch comic book store and art gallery in Amsterdam, founded on November 8, 1968 by Kees Kousemaker. His son Boris Kousemaker has been the owner since 2007.

pois.name: Albert Cuyp-markt
pois.intro: The Albert Cuyp Market is a street market in Amsterdam, The Netherlands, on the Albert Cuypstraat between Ferdinand Bolstraat and Van Woustraat, in the De Pijp area of the Oud-Zuid district of the city. The street and market are named for Albert Cuyp, a painter from the 17th century.

pois.name: Bloemenmarkt
pois.intro: The Bloemenmarkt is the world's only floating flower market. Founded in 1862, it is sited in Amsterdam, Netherlands, on the Singel canal between Muntplein and Koningsplein in the city's southern canal belt.

pois.name: Dappermarkt
pois.intro: The Dappermarkt is a market on Dapperstraat in Amsterdam-East and is one of the busiest markets of Amsterdam, The Netherlands. In 1910, the Dapperstraat was officially designated by the municipality of Amsterdam as a market street.

pois.name: Magna Plaza
pois.intro: The former Amsterdam Main Post Office, now the Magna Plaza shopping centre, is a monumental building located at Nieuwezijds Voorburgwal 182 in Amsterdam, Netherlands. It was built in 1895–1899 in neo-Gothic and neo-Renaissance style.

pois.name: Kalverpassage
pois.intro: The Kalvertoren, a shopping center in Amsterdam, is located on Kalverstraat, Amsterdam's busiest shopping street. The project was developed by Multi Corporation.

pois.name: Xantippe
pois.intro: Xantippe was de eerste vrouwenboekhandel van Amsterdam. De winkel begon in 1976 aan de Westerstraat 193 en verhuisde in 1980 naar de Prinsengracht 290, waar de naam op een gegeven moment werd gewijzigd in Xantippe Unlimited.

pois.name: Frank's Smoke House
pois.description: Restaurant en winkel voor gerookte vis

pois.name: Museumplein
pois.intro: The Museumplein is a public space in the Museumkwartier neighbourhood of the Amsterdam-Zuid borough in Amsterdam, Netherlands. Located at the Museumplein are three major museums – the Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh Museum, and Stedelijk Museum – and the concert hall Concertgebouw.

pois.name: Blauwbrug
pois.intro: The Blauwbrug is a historic bridge in Amsterdam, Netherlands over the river Amstel. It connects the Rembrandtplein area with the Waterlooplein area, and lies south to the Stopera.

pois.name: Oosterpark
pois.intro: The Oosterpark is the first large park laid out by the municipality of Amsterdam. Located near the Singelgracht of the Mauritskade to the north, it is the principal component of the Oosterpark neighbourhood in the Oost borough.

pois.name: Botanische Tuin Zuidas
pois.description: botanical garden, Hortus Botanicus Vrije Universiteit
pois.intro: The Botanic Garden Zuidas is a botanical garden belonging to Vrije Universiteit in Amsterdam, Netherlands. It was established in 1967 for the purpose of education and research for the Biology faculty.

pois.name: Sarphatipark
pois.intro: The Sarphatipark is a public urban park located in the stadsdeel Amsterdam Oud-Zuid in Amsterdam, Netherlands. The park is named after Samuel Sarphati.

pois.name: Amstelpark
pois.intro: The Amstelpark is a park in Amsterdam-Zuid. The park includes a labyrinth, a café, a restaurant, two galleries, an orangery, a petting zoo and a mini-golf course.

pois.name: Flevopark
pois.intro: Flevopark is a park located in the Indische Buurt, in the eastern portion of the city of Amsterdam, in the province of North Holland, Netherlands. The park contains a playground, tennis courts, the youth centre "Jeugdland", an outdoor swimming pool, large lawns, barbecue areas, a terrace and several trails for running.

pois.name: Hollandsche Manege
pois.nameEnglish: Dutch Equestrian School Museum Hollandsche Manege
pois.intro: The Hollandsche Manege in Amsterdam is the oldest riding school in the Netherlands, dating back to 1744. The current building, inspired by the Spanish Riding School in Vienna, was constructed in 1882.

pois.name: Deutzenhofje
pois.intro: The Deutzen Hofje or Deutzenhofje is a 17th-century hofje on the Prinsengracht 857 in Amsterdam. It is the largest hofje built in the 17th century.

pois.name: Normaal Amsterdams Peil
pois.intro: Amsterdam Ordnance Datum or Normaal Amsterdams Peil is a vertical datum in use in large parts of Western Europe. Originally created for use in the Netherlands, its height was used by Prussia in 1879 for defining Normalnull, and in 1955 by other European countries.

pois.name: Prostitutie Informatie Centrum
pois.description: Information for tourists, customers and sex workers about prostitution in the red light district
pois.intro: The Prostitution Information Center is located in the heart of Amsterdam in the red light district, near Amsterdam's Old Church. The PIC serves as an educational centre and resource for providing Amsterdam's visitors with information and advice about prostitution.

pois.name: Beurs van Berlage
pois.intro: The Beurs van Berlage is a building on the Damrak, in the centre of Amsterdam. It was designed by architect Hendrik Petrus Berlage and constructed between 1896 and 1903.

pois.name: Waag
pois.description: Waag Society
pois.intro: The Waag is a 15th-century building on Nieuwmarkt square in Amsterdam. It was originally a city gate and part of the walls of Amsterdam.

pois.name: Zuiderkerk
pois.description: former protestant church in Renaissance style.
pois.intro: The Zuiderkerk is a 17th-century Reformed Protestant church in the Nieuwmarkt area of Amsterdam, the capital of the Netherlands. The church played an important part in the life of Rembrandt and was the subject of a painting by Claude Monet.

pois.name: The Amsterdam Dungeon
pois.intro: The Amsterdam Dungeon is a haunted attraction in central Amsterdam, Netherlands. It depicts history through an interactive adventure, using live actors, a ride, shows and special effects to simulate historical dark and bleak times.

pois.name: Magere Brug
pois.intro: The Magere Brug is a bridge over the river Amstel in Amsterdam, Netherlands. It connects the banks of the river at Kerkstraat, between the Keizersgracht and Prinsengracht.

pois.name: Portugese Synagoge
pois.intro: The Portuguese Synagogue, also known as the Esnoga, or Snoge, is an Orthodox Jewish congregation and synagogue, located at Mr. Visserplein 3 in Central Amsterdam, Amsterdam, in the North Holland region of The Netherlands.

pois.description: Portuguese Pastries
